notes.title: v0.3.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Adjusted volume of certain elements
- Fixed a bug causing end 1 audio to not play correctly
- Fixed a bug caused by pausing during the credits

notes.title: v0.3 - v0.3.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
v0.3
Features:
- The game is now feature complete from beginning to the main ending

Bugs:
- Fixed an issue where custom mode start button wouldn't start the game
- Ensured you couldn't crash the game by not selecting mechanics before starting custom mode
- Fixed an issue where endless mode start button wouldn't start the game
- Fixed an issue allowing the player to halt quitting the game by right clicking while it closed

v0.3.1
Features:
- Added a chapter select menu to the main menu after completing the game
- Added a "current chapter" text box to the main menu after completing the tutorial
- Added "Send Feedback" button to better faciliate people giving feedback
- Added ending counter to show how many endings one has seen - not fully functional yet

Bugs:
- Fixed scaling slider not adjusting properly
- Fixed progress tracking for post-game game modes
- Fixed achievement unlock functionality
- Fixed jumpscares in the menu (for real this time!)
- Fixed hour 3 cutscene not triggering

v0.3.2
Bugs:
- Deleting save data now properly resets post game status
- Fixed an issue causing RNG to increase too quickly
- Fixed an issue allowing random events to play during cutscenes
- Fixed an issue causing particle effects to not load after a jumpscare
- Fixed the lightning round
- Fixed menu light switch sound effects
- Fixed an issue allowing the hour 5 track to play on the main menu
- Fixed multiple situations in which jumpscares could potentially play more than once in a row

v0.3.3
- All Endings are now in place
- Ending Counter now works
- Fixed an issue allowing the hour 5 track to play on the main menu (for real this time)

v0.3.4
- Visual polish
- Added a custom cursor
- Fixed some pausing issues

v0.3.5
- Proper demo handling

v0.3.6
- Small changes to hour 5
- Small changes to particle emission

v0.26.2:
Features

Bugs

- Fixed a lot of input management issues, should no longer be able to spam right click and cause problems
- Fixed potential crashes caused by spamming right click at certain points
